title: Rule 7 fe80::/64 mode conflicts with Rust fe80::/10 predicate and corrupts addresses
description: Security/interoperability review finding: spec/03-adaptation.md requires Rule 7 AddressMode=0 only when both addresses have the exact canonical fe80::/64 prefix, sending only their 64-bit IIDs; otherwise it requires full 128-bit addresses. rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs currently uses is_link_local(), which recognizes all fe80::/10 addresses, for both compression selection and decompression canonicality. For a valid link-local address with nonzero bits 10..63, compression discards those bits and reconstructs a different source or destination. Full-mode encoding of the same address can also be rejected. This can misroute traffic or change endpoint identity across a SCHC hop.
acceptance_criteria: Rule 7 mode selection uses an exact canonical fe80::/64 predicate for IID-only compression. Addresses within fe80::/10 but outside that /64 either use full-address mode and round-trip unchanged or normatively fall back to Rule 255; all implementations choose the same behavior. Tests/vectors include source and destination addresses with nonzero bits 10..63 and prove that no address bits are lost, no endpoint changes, and the canonical fe80::/64 case still uses AddressMode=0.
